Officials say promoters collected about ₹120 crore from the public. The investigation continues, but no final finding about guilt or repayment is reported.

cards.takeaway_english: The investigation has begun, but the money’s final destination remains unclear.

why_it_matters.english: Promises of fixed returns can influence everyday saving decisions.

cards.english_title: RBI Creates a New Financial Markets Advisory Committee
cards.korean_desc: 2026년 11월 4일 RBI가 금융시장 자문위를 발표했습니다 이번 조치는 빠른 시장 변화와 금융 위험에 대응합니다 위원들은 돈, 국채, 외환과 파생상품을 논의합니다 위원회는 적어도 분기마다 한 번 회의합니다
cards.english_desc: On November 4, 2026, RBI announced a Technical Consultative Committee for Financial Markets. The move responds to rapidly changing markets, systems and financial risks. Members will discuss money, government securities, foreign exchange and related derivatives. The committee must meet at least once every quarter.
cards.hook: RBI created a committee for changing financial markets.
cards.takeaway_english: The committee creates a formal channel, while its influence will depend on future recommendations.
cards.takeaway_korean: 위원회는 공식 통로를 만들었고 영향력은 앞으로 결정됩니다

why_it_matters.english: Market rules can affect borrowing, investing and currency trading.
why_it_matters.korean: 시장 규칙은 대출, 투자, 환거래에 영향을 줍니다

why_it_matters.english: Better infrastructure can support smoother financial transactions.
why_it_matters.korean: 더 나은 기반시설은 금융 거래를 원활하게 합니다

parties.label: Reserve Bank of India
parties.english: It will chair and use the committee for policy consultation.

parties.label: Market participants
parties.english: They will provide structured input on markets and infrastructure.
parties.korean: 시장 관계자들은 시장과 기반시설 의견을 냅니다

parties.label: External members
parties.english: Seven named members come from regulation, banking, clearing and investment.

views.label: RBI
views.english: The committee can improve efficiency, liquidity and resilience across financial markets.
views.korean: RBI는 시장 효율성, 유동성, 회복력이 좋아질 수 있다고 봅니다

views.label: Market participants
views.english: Regular consultation may help identify operational problems and unintended market frictions.
views.korean: 정기 협의는 운영 문제와 시장 마찰을 찾는 데 도움 됩니다

disagree.english: A committee can advise, but the announcement does not show which recommendations will become rules.
disagree.korean: 위원회는 조언하지만 어떤 의견이 규칙이 될지는 발표하지 않았습니다

cards.reader_question_korean: 금융 당국은 시장과 더 자주 논의해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Chennai’s Deepavali Sweet Bazaars Add Classics and Surprises
cards.korean_desc: 첸나이 요리사 6곳이 디왈리 과자 시장을 열었습니다 전통 과자는 인기였고 블루베리 카주 카틀리도 추가됐습니다 기업 선물 주문과 해외 배송이 사업을 크게 도왔습니다 시장은 2026년 11월 7일까지 더 많은 메뉴로 엽니다
cards.english_desc: Six Chennai caterers opened Deepavali sweet bazaars with freshly prepared festive foods. Classic sweets remained popular, while sellers added blueberry kaju katli and baklava. Corporate gift orders and overseas courier deliveries supplied much of the business. The bazaars remain open until November 7, 2026, with wider menus and more locations.
cards.hook: Chennai caterers raised prices, but shoppers kept coming.
cards.takeaway_english: Chennai’s festive sweet trade is expanding its menu, locations and delivery reach.
cards.takeaway_korean: 첸나이 명절 과자 시장은 메뉴와 배송을 넓혔습니다

why_it_matters.english: Food prices affect festive shopping and family gift plans.
why_it_matters.korean: 식품 가격은 명절 쇼핑과 가족 선물에 영향을 줍니다

why_it_matters.english: Bazaars connect local cooking with overseas family celebrations.
why_it_matters.korean: 시장은 지역 음식과 해외 가족 행사를 연결합니다

parties.label: Chennai caterers
parties.english: They opened festive bazaars with sweets, savouries and gift boxes.
parties.korean: 첸나이 요리사들은 과자와 선물 상자를 팔았습니다

parties.label: Corporate buyers
parties.english: Bulk festive orders provide a significant share of business.
parties.korean: 기업 대량 주문은 사업의 큰 부분입니다

parties.label: Customers abroad
parties.english: Customers in the United States and elsewhere receive courier orders.

views.label: Customers
views.english: Demand remained strong despite higher prices and seasonal crowds.

cards.english_title: India’s Young Pacers Bowl New Zealand Out for 185
cards.korean_desc: 인도 주전 빠른 투수들은 관리와 부상으로 빠졌습니다 아르시딥은 4개, 구르누르는 3개, 캄보즈는 2개를 잡았습니다 뉴질랜드는 50오버 대신 40.2오버에 이닝을 끝냈습니다
cards.english_desc: India’s usual fast bowlers were missing because of workload management and injuries. Arshdeep took four wickets, Gurnoor three, and Kamboj two. New Zealand finished its innings in 40.2 overs instead of 50.
cards.hook: India’s attack bowled New Zealand out for 185.
cards.takeaway_english: India seized early control, but the first ODI still required a successful chase.
cards.takeaway_korean: 인도는 초반 주도권을 잡았지만 추격 성공이 필요했습니다

why_it_matters.english: Young replacements showed how team depth can shape a series.
why_it_matters.korean: 젊은 대체 선수들이 팀의 깊이를 보여줬습니다

cards.english_title: Kuchipudi Turns the Hanuman Chalisa into Dance
cards.korean_desc: 스리모이 벰파티가 바르티야 비디야 바반에서 쿠치푸디 작품을 공연했습니다 춤은 라마야나와 하누만 찰리사의 하누만 이야기를 따릅니다 무용수들은 라마와의 만남, 랑카, 전투와 시타를 보여줬습니다 이 작품은 첸나이 아카데미의 쿠치푸디 전통을 이었습니다
cards.english_desc: Srimoyi Vempati presented KAPISUTRA in Kuchipudi at Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan. The dance follows Hanuman through episodes from the Ramayana and Hanuman Chalisa. Dancers showed Rama’s meeting with Hanuman, Lanka’s journey, battle and Sita’s discovery. The production continues the academy’s Kuchipudi legacy in Chennai.
cards.hook: A Kuchipudi production brought Hanuman’s story to life.
cards.takeaway_english: The production shows how devotion, storytelling and classical technique can share one stage.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이 공연은 신앙과 이야기와 기법을 한 무대에 담았습니다

why_it_matters.english: Classical dance can carry religious stories to new audiences.
why_it_matters.korean: 고전무용은 종교 이야기를 새 관객에게 전할 수 있습니다

why_it_matters.english: The production connects Kuchipudi teaching with Chennai’s cultural life.
why_it_matters.korean: 공연은 쿠치푸디 교육과 첸나이 문화를 연결합니다

parties.label: Srimoyi Vempati
parties.english: She created, choreographed and performed the production.

parties.label: Kuchipudi Art Academy students
parties.english: They performed multiple roles in the production.
parties.korean: 쿠치푸디 아카데미 학생들은 여러 역할을 맡았습니다

parties.label: Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan audience
parties.english: They saw a devotional dance interpretation of Hanuman Chalisa episodes.
parties.korean: 관객들은 하누만 찰리사 장면을 춤으로 보았습니다

views.korean: 공연은 연기, 움직임, 음악과 조명으로 좋은 평가를 받았습니다

views.label: Kuchipudi Art Academy

views.korean: 이 작품은 첸나이에서 구루 벰파티의 전통을 잇습니다

cards.english_title: Abdul El-Sayed Claims a Historic Michigan Senate Victory
cards.korean_desc: 빈 의석은 양당의 상원 주도권 경쟁 때문에 중요했습니다 엘사예드는 보편적 의료와 큰 병원비 지원을 약속했습니다 확정되면 그는 미국 상원의 첫 무슬림 의원이 됩니다
cards.english_desc: The open seat mattered because Democrats and Republicans were competing for Senate control. El-Sayed promised universal health care and help for voters facing large medical bills. If confirmed, he would become the first Muslim elected to the U.S. Senate.
cards.hook: Abdul El-Sayed claimed victory over Mike Rogers.
cards.korean_hook: 압둘 엘사예드가 마이크 로저스에 승리를 선언했습니다
cards.takeaway_english: Michigan’s result could reshape Senate politics and broaden representation in Washington.
cards.takeaway_korean: 미시간 결과는 상원 정치와 워싱턴 대표성을 바꿀 수 있습니다

why_it_matters.english: Health care costs were a major promise in the campaign.
The result could mark a major religious first in the Senate.
why_it_matters.korean: 결과는 상원에서 중요한 종교적 첫 기록이 될 수 있습니다

parties.label: Abdul El-Sayed
parties.english: The Democrat campaigned on universal health care and changing politics.
parties.korean: 민주당 후보는 보편적 의료와 정치 변화를 내세웠습니다

parties.label: Mike Rogers
parties.english: The Republican was El-Sayed’s opponent in Michigan’s open Senate race.
parties.korean: 공화당 후보는 미시간 상원 선거에서 맞붙었습니다

parties.label: Michigan Democrats
parties.english: They could gain a key Senate seat if the result is confirmed.
parties.korean: 결과가 확정되면 중요한 상원 의석을 얻을 수 있습니다

views.label: El-Sayed’s campaign
views.english: It presented health care costs and economic pressure as central voter concerns.
views.korean: 선거운동은 의료비와 경제 압박을 핵심 문제로 제시했습니다

views.english: Republicans attacked El-Sayed as dangerous and tied him to far-left politics.
